title: Tirumala 3 (P13) — Evidence, Assumptions & Provisional Porch Drop Register

owner_confirmed_facts.value: Northeast (NE) corner plot with an EAST-facing principal entrance.
owner_confirmed_facts.notes: 'Northeast corner plot' describes the two adjoining roads (North and East); the front entrance faces East.

owner_confirmed_facts.item: Revision 8 care suite & open NW corner garden
owner_confirmed_facts.value: Revision 8 permits the Ground Floor Care Suite (g-care) to extend beyond the 25 ft midpoint across Options A–E (y = 21..39 ft) while preserving the open Northwest corner garden, a 3 ft clear North passage with boundary-plane greenery, and a 7 × 3.5 ft South-to-North bed (head South, feet North).

Pair of light-coloured electrical feeder cabinets of differing sizes (smaller cabinet on left/east, taller louvred cabinet on right/west), surrounding green hedge, low brown-grey boundary wall, interlocking paver verge, trees, and nearby streetlight pole.

Southward view across the 12 m North road toward the plot's North frontage (East on image-left, West on image-right), showing low boundary wall, hedge, interlocking pavers, streetlight pole, and roadside vegetation. Temporary parked white car excluded.

Oblique East/Southeast view across the 9 m East road toward the tall pale metal mesh basketball-court enclosure, repeated tubular posts, coconut palms, leafy trees, raised planting bed, hedge, pavers, and lights.
Cross-check leftward view from the North road toward the East court enclosure, paved passage, and low corner wall.
Close-up near the Northeast corner showing weathered masonry pillar with cream/ochre cap, low wall, hedge, paver footpath, and corner planting.
